metadata.description: Argus — keeps important decisions alive as courses.

plugins.name: argus
plugins.description: Decision-voyage harness. Keeps important decisions alive as courses: clarifies the real question, puts an agent crew to work on real code/PRs/files, verifies their claims, and returns a one-screen Current Bearing — plus a falsifiable decision contract you later settle against reality (/argus:settle, /argus:log).

plugins.name: argus-driver
plugins.description: Thin driver for the argus-decision-mcp server: installing wires the MCP (stdio) automatically and ships the durable-ledger-aware statusline. Seal a falsifiable prediction, settle it against reality — the model never grades you.
